subtasks: Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.
Use the left gripper to nudge the free end of the blue T's stem slightly toward the far edge of the table so the stem and crossbar match the gray outline. Keep the block flat.
Gently push the far end of the blue crossbar toward the near edge of the table until both the blue crossbar and stem cover the gray outline. Keep the block flat.
Withdraw without touching the T again, fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
